% Project macros, read through \input{macros}: one of each definition kind the math
% renderer feeds MathJax (LaTeX Live design 4.2).
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand\N{\mathbb{N}}
\newcommand*{\Z}{\mathbb{Z}}
\newcommand{\norm}[1]{\left\lVert #1 \right\rVert}
\newcommand{\inner}[2]{\left\langle #1, #2 \right\rangle}
\newcommand{\E}[2][]{\mathbb{E}_{#1}\left[ #2 \right]}
\newcommand{\loss}[1][\theta]{\mathcal{L}(#1)}
\providecommand{\Q}{\mathbb{Q}}
\providecommand{\R}{\mathrm{R}}
\DeclareRobustCommand{\half}{\tfrac{1}{2}}
\NewDocumentCommand{\abs}{m}{\left\lvert #1 \right\rvert}
\NewDocumentCommand{\dd}{O{}m}{\mathrm{d}^{#1}#2}
\NewDocumentCommand{\set}{m o}{\left\{ #1 \IfValueT{#2}{\;\middle|\; #2} \right\}}
\DeclareMathOperator{\Var}{Var}
\DeclareMathOperator*{\argmin}{arg\,min}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\ceil}{\lceil}{\rceil}
\DeclarePairedDelimiterX{\braces}[1]{\{}{\}}{#1}
\def\eps{\varepsilon}
\def\pair#1,#2.{(#1;#2)}
\let\oldphi\phi
\renewcommand{\phi}{\varphi}
\newenvironment{mat}{\begin{pmatrix}}{\end{pmatrix}}
\definecolor{accent}{RGB}{0,120,2}
\newcommand{\nc}{\newcommand}
\nc{\Prob}{\mathbb{P}}
% \newcommand{\hidden}{commented out}

\makeatletter
\newcommand{\bk@pair}[2]{(#1,#2)}
\newcommand{\bkPair}{\bk@pair}
\makeatother
